actors.name: Santiago Abascal
actors.blurb: Abascal continues to drive media coverage through his party's negotiations with the People's Party (PP) for regional governance in Andalusia and other parts of Spain. His accusations of electoral fraud and calls for a no-confidence motion against Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez have kept Vox in the spotlight. The party's stance on social issues, such as LGBTQ+ rights, also generates significant debate.
